items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Then we had an old, old trombone player way back there on the Joe Pitti, old trombone player. He was good. What was his name again? [INTERVIEWER] Joe Pitti.

ctx.x: He wasn't a good reader. Still playing, you know? Yeah. He was doing good and making money. He wasn't reading trombone player. But he was good. See? He could catch a thing and play a good one on it already. You don't worry about that. Either one of them. Yes. He was good. And Vic Gastra, fine trombone player. Buddy Johnson, fine. And Buddy Johnson's brother, Yank, he called him. He was a good trombone player. Then the fellas came up back to give my time. I'm trying to tell you about it, but I don't know what it…
